failures.description: A new harness assertion incorrectly required a literal aria-label attribute. The React Native button already had the correct visible and accessible text. Assertion changed to exact visible text; readable-choice screenshot was inspected.

A real worker-generated PDF parsed successfully but lacked a human team name. The Roma readability assertion was retained. Source607 added trusted public display metadata and focused scenario02 then passed.

Browser entry failed while the execution-host transport was disconnected. The owned static server still listened but returned empty HTTP replies, and its exec session could not resume. Restarting only that process with file-redirected logs restored HTTP 200; scenarios 03–05 then passed. A broken inherited log pipe was suspected, not independently proven.

handling: Original failed attempts remain retained privately. Sanitized reasons and digests preserve the failures without copying logs, downloaded data or invitation material.
